body.name: RowRecover
body.def: \(\rho_i(\Pi_A\mathbf K)\) is the unique class in the observational row orbit not among the lifted interventional residual-unmixing rows \(\{[\Lambda_i(v,T_{\{i\}})]:[v]\in\mathscr R_i\}\); its representative normalized to coordinate \(i\) equal to one gives \(\operatorname{row}_i(B)=e_i^\top-q_i^\top\).
